ESV.1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
ESV.2: “Speak to the people of Israel and say to them, I am the LORD your God.
ESV.3: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived, and you shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, to which I am bringing you. You shall not walk in their statutes.
ESV.4: You shall follow my rules  and keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.
ESV.5: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my rules; if a person does them, he shall live by them: I am the LORD.
ESV.6: “None of you shall approach any one of his close relatives to uncover nakedness. I am the LORD.
ESV.7: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, which is the nakedness of your mother; she is your mother, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
ESV.8: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife; it is your father's nakedness.
ESV.9: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, your father's daughter or your mother's daughter, whether brought up in the family or in another home.
ESV.10: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son's daughter or of your daughter's daughter, for their nakedness is your own nakedness.
ESV.11: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife's daughter, brought up in your father's family, since she is your sister.
ESV.12: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister; she is your father's relative.
ESV.13: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister, for she is your mother's relative.
ESV.14: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother, that is, you shall not approach his wife; she is your aunt.
ESV.15: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law; she is your son's wife, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
ESV.16: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife; it is your brother's nakedness.
ESV.17: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and of her daughter, and you shall not take her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter to uncover her nakedness; they are relatives; it is depravity.
ESV.18: And you shall not take a woman as a rival wife to her sister, uncovering her nakedness while her sister is still alive.
ESV.19: “You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness while she is in her menstrual uncleanness.
ESV.20: And you shall not lie sexually with your neighbor's wife and so make yourself unclean with her.
ESV.21: You shall not give any of your children to offer them  to Molech, and so profane the name of your God: I am the LORD.
ESV.22: You shall not lie with a male as with a woman; it is an abomination.
ESV.23: And you shall not lie with any animal and so make yourself unclean with it, neither shall any woman give herself to an animal to lie with it: it is perversion.
ESV.24: “Do not make yourselves unclean by any of these things, for by all these the nations I am driving out before you have become unclean,
ESV.25: and the land became unclean, so that I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.
ESV.26: But you shall keep my statutes and my rules and do none of these abominations, either the native or the stranger who sojourns among you
ESV.27: (for the people of the land, who were before you, did all of these abominations, so that the land became unclean),
ESV.28: lest the land vomit you out when you make it unclean, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
ESV.29: For everyone who does any of these abominations, the persons who do them shall be cut off from among their people.
ESV.30: So keep my charge never to practice any of these abominable customs that were practiced before you, and never to make yourselves unclean by them: I am the LORD your God.”

NKJV.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NKJV.2: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘I am the LORD your God.
NKJV.3: According to the doings of the land of Egypt, where you dwelt, you shall not do; and according to the doings of the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you, you shall not do; nor shall you walk in their ordinances.
NKJV.4: You shall observe My judgments and keep My ordinances, to walk in them: I am the LORD your God.
NKJV.5: You shall therefore keep My statutes and My judgments, which if a man does, he shall live by them: I am the LORD.
NKJV.6: ‘None of you shall approach anyone who is near of kin to him, to uncover his nakedness: I am the LORD.
NKJV.7: The nakedness of your father or the nakedness of your mother you shall not uncover. She is your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
NKJV.8: The nakedness of your father’s wife you shall not uncover; it is your father’s nakedness.
NKJV.9: The nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or elsewhere, their nakedness you shall not uncover.
NKJV.10: The nakedness of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, their nakedness you shall not uncover; for theirs is your own nakedness.
NKJV.11: The nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, begotten by your father—she is your sister—you shall not uncover her nakedness.
NKJV.12: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister; she is near of kin to your father.
NKJV.13: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is near of kin to your mother.
NKJV.14: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife; she is your aunt.
NKJV.15: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law—she is your son’s wife—you shall not uncover her nakedness.
NKJV.16: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife; it is your brother’s nakedness.
NKJV.17: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, nor shall you take her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near of kin to her. It is wickedness.
NKJV.18: Nor shall you take a woman as a rival to her sister, to uncover her nakedness while the other is alive.
NKJV.19: ‘Also you shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness as long as she is in her customary impurity.
NKJV.20: Moreover you shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, to defile yourself with her.
NKJV.21: And you shall not let any of your descendants pass through the fire to Molech, nor shall you profane the name of your God: I am the LORD.
NKJV.22: You shall not lie with a male as with a woman. It is an abomination.
NKJV.23: Nor shall you mate with any animal, to defile yourself with it. Nor shall any woman stand before an animal to mate with it. It is perversion.
NKJV.24: ‘Do not defile yourselves with any of these things; for by all these the nations are defiled, which I am casting out before you.
NKJV.25: For the land is defiled; therefore I visit the punishment of its iniquity upon it, and the land vomits out its inhabitants.
NKJV.26: You shall therefore keep My statutes and My judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations, either any of your own nation or any stranger who dwells among you
NKJV.27: (for all these abominations the men of the land have done, who were before you, and thus the land is defiled),
NKJV.28: lest the land vomit you out also when you defile it, as it vomited out the nations that were before you.
NKJV.29: For whoever commits any of these abominations, the persons who commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
NKJV.30: ‘Therefore you shall keep My ordinance, so that you do not commit any of these abominable customs which were committed before you, and that you do not defile yourselves by them: I am the LORD your God.’ ”

NASB.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
NASB.2: 'Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, 'I am the LORD your God.
NASB.3: 'You shall not do what is done in the land of Egypt where you lived, nor are you to do what is done in the land of Canaan where I am bringing you; you shall not walk in their statutes.
NASB.4: 'You are to perform My judgments and keep My statutes, to live in accord with them; I am the LORD your God.
NASB.5: 'So you shall keep My statutes and My judgments, by which a man may live if he does them; I am the LORD.
NASB.6: 'None of you shall approach any blood relative of his to uncover nakedness; I am the LORD.
NASB.7: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, that is, the nakedness of your mother. She is your mother; you are not to uncover her nakedness.
NASB.8: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife; it is your father's nakedness.
NASB.9: 'The nakedness of your sister, [either] your father's daughter or your mother's daughter, whether born at home or born outside, their nakedness you shall not uncover.
NASB.10: 'The nakedness of your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter, their nakedness you shall not uncover; for their nakedness is yours.
NASB.11: 'The nakedness of your father's wife's daughter, born to your father, she is your sister, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
NASB.12: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister; she is your father's blood relative.
NASB.13: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister, for she is your mother's blood relative.
NASB.14: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother; you shall not approach his wife, she is your aunt.
NASB.15: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law; she is your son's wife, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
NASB.16: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife; it is your brother's nakedness.
NASB.17: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and of her daughter, nor shall you take her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are blood relatives. It is lewdness.
NASB.18: 'You shall not marry a woman in addition to her sister as a rival while she is alive, to uncover her nakedness.
NASB.19: 'Also you shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness during her menstrual impurity.
NASB.20: 'You shall not have intercourse with your neighbor's wife, to be defiled with her.
NASB.21: 'You shall not give any of your offspring to offer them to Molech, nor shall you profane the name of your God; I am the LORD.
NASB.22: 'You shall not lie with a male as one lies with a female; it is an abomination.
NASB.23: 'Also you shall not have intercourse with any animal to be defiled with it, nor shall any woman stand before an animal to mate with it; it is a perversion.
NASB.24: 'Do not defile yourselves by any of these things; for by all these the nations which I am casting out before you have become defiled.
NASB.25: 'For the land has become defiled, therefore I have brought its punishment upon it, so the land has spewed out its inhabitants.
NASB.26: 'But as for you, you are to keep My statutes and My judgments and shall not do any of these abominations, [neither] the native, nor the alien who sojourns among you
NASB.27: (for the men of the land who have been before you have done all these abominations, and the land has become defiled);
NASB.28: so that the land will not spew you out, should you defile it, as it has spewed out the nation which has been before you.
NASB.29: 'For whoever does any of these abominations, those persons who do [so] shall be cut off from among their people.
NASB.30: 'Thus you are to keep My charge, that you do not practice any of the abominable customs which have been practiced before you, so as not to defile yourselves with them; I am the LORD your God.''

NLT.1: Then the LORD said to Moses,
NLT.2: “Give the following instructions to the people of Israel. I am the LORD your God.
NLT.3: So do not act like the people in Egypt, where you used to live, or like the people of Canaan, where I am taking you. You must not imitate their way of life.
NLT.4: You must obey all my regulations and be careful to obey my decrees, for I am the LORD your God.
NLT.5: If you obey my decrees and my regulations, you will find life through them. I am the LORD.
NLT.6: “You must never have sexual relations with a close relative, for I am the LORD.
NLT.7: “Do not violate your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; you must not have sexual relations with her.
NLT.8: “Do not have sexual relations with any of your father’s wives, for this would violate your father.
NLT.9: “Do not have sexual relations with your sister or half sister, whether she is your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born into your household or someone else’s.
NLT.10: “Do not have sexual relations with your granddaughter, whether she is your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, for this would violate yourself.
NLT.11: “Do not have sexual relations with your stepsister, the daughter of any of your father’s wives, for she is your sister.
NLT.12: “Do not have sexual relations with your father’s sister, for she is your father’s close relative.
NLT.13: “Do not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s close relative.
NLT.14: “Do not violate your uncle, your father’s brother, by having sexual relations with his wife, for she is your aunt.
NLT.15: “Do not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law; she is your son’s wife, so you must not have sexual relations with her.
NLT.16: “Do not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife, for this would violate your brother.
NLT.17: “Do not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. And do not take her granddaughter, whether her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter, and have sexual relations with her. They are close relatives, and this would be a wicked act.
NLT.18: “While your wife is living, do not marry her sister and have sexual relations with her, for they would be rivals.
NLT.19: “Do not have sexual relations with a woman during her period of menstrual impurity.
NLT.20: “Do not defile yourself by having sexual intercourse with your neighbor’s wife.
NLT.21: “Do not permit any of your children to be offered as a sacrifice to Molech, for you must not bring shame on the name of your God. I am the LORD.
NLT.22: “Do not practice homosexuality, having sex with another man as with a woman. It is a detestable sin.
NLT.23: “A man must not defile himself by having sex with an animal. And a woman must not offer herself to a male animal to have intercourse with it. This is a perverse act.
NLT.24: “Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, for the people I am driving out before you have defiled themselves in all these ways.
NLT.25: Because the entire land has become defiled, I am punishing the people who live there. I will cause the land to vomit them out.
NLT.26: You must obey all my decrees and regulations. You must not commit any of these detestable sins. This applies both to native-born Israelites and to the foreigners living among you.
NLT.27: “All these detestable activities are practiced by the people of the land where I am taking you, and this is how the land has become defiled.
NLT.28: So do not defile the land and give it a reason to vomit you out, as it will vomit out the people who live there now.
NLT.29: Whoever commits any of these detestable sins will be cut off from the community of Israel.
NLT.30: So obey my instructions, and do not defile yourselves by committing any of these detestable practices that were committed by the people who lived in the land before you. I am the LORD your God.”

AMP.1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
AMP.2: "Speak to the children of Israel and say to them, 'I am the LORD your God.
AMP.3: You shall not do what is done in the land of Egypt where you lived, and you shall not do what is done in the land of Canaan where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes (practices, customs).
AMP.4: You are to follow My judgments (precepts, ordinances) and keep My statutes and live by them. I am the LORD your God.
AMP.5: So you shall keep My statutes and My judgments, by which, if a person keeps them, he shall live; I am the LORD.
AMP.6: ' No one shall approach any blood relative of his to uncover nakedness (have intimate relations). I am the LORD.
AMP.7: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, that is, the nakedness of your mother. She is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
AMP.8: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife; it is your father's nakedness.
AMP.9: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, either the daughter of your father or of your mother, whether born at home or born elsewhere.
AMP.10: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter; their nakedness you shall not uncover, for they are your own nakedness [that is, your own descendants].
AMP.11: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's wife's daughter; born to your father, she is your sister.
AMP.12: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister; she is your father's blood relative.
AMP.13: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister, for she is your mother's blood relative.
AMP.14: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother's wife; you shall not approach his wife; she is your aunt.
AMP.15: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law; she is your son's wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
AMP.16: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife; it is your brother's nakedness.
AMP.17: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, nor shall you take her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter to uncover their nakedness (have intimate relations with them); they are [her] blood relatives; it is an outrageous offense.
AMP.18: You shall not marry a woman in addition to her sister as a rival while she is alive, to uncover her nakedness.
AMP.19: 'Also you shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness during her menstrual impurity and ceremonial uncleanness.
AMP.20: You shall not have intimate relations with your neighbor's wife, to be defiled with her.
AMP.21: You shall not give any of your children to offer them [by fire as a sacrifice] to Molech [the god of the Ammonites], nor shall you profane the name of your God [by honoring idols as gods]. I am the LORD.
AMP.22: You shall not lie [intimately] with a male as one lies with a female; it is repulsive.
AMP.23: You shall not have intimate relations with any animal to be defiled with it; nor shall a woman stand before an animal to mate with it; it is a perversion.
AMP.24: 'Do not defile yourselves by any of these things; for by all these the nations which I am casting out before you have become defiled.
AMP.25: For the land has become defiled; therefore I have brought its punishment upon it, and the land vomits out its inhabitants.
AMP.26: But as for you, you are to keep My statutes and My judgments (precepts) and shall not commit any of these repulsive acts, neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives temporarily among you
AMP.27: (for all these repulsive acts have been done by the men who lived in the land before you, and the land has become defiled);
AMP.28: [do none of these things] so that the land will not vomit you out, should you defile it, as it has vomited out the nation which has been before you.
AMP.29: For whoever commits any of these repulsive acts, those persons who do so shall be cut off from among their people [excluding them from the atonement made for them].
